question: As per World Justice Project 2020, what is India’s rank in Regulatory Enforcement as cited in the Economic Survey of India 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**79.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per** World Justice Project 2020**, India’s rank is **79 Regulatory Enforcement** as cited in the Economic Survey of India 2021.
 
• India has been ranked at 79th spot among 139 countries in the World Justice Project (WJP) Rule of Law Index 2021.
 
• The report measures how the rule of law is experienced and perceived across the world by the general public, legal practitioners, and experts, in practical and everyday situations.
 
• The WJP's framework covers eight factors.
 
• Denmark has topped the index, followed by Norway and Finland.
 
• India's score places it at 3 out of 6 countries in the South Asia region and 9 out of 35 among lower middle-income countries.
 
• Regionally, South Asia's top performer in the Index is Nepal (70th out of 139 countries globally), followed by Sri Lanka and India.
 
• The Democratic Republic of the Congo, Cambodia, and Venezuela had the lowest overall rule of law scores.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About World Justice Project (WJP) Rule of Law Index 2021:**

 
 
• The WJP Rule of Law Index is the world's leading source for original, independent data on the rule of law.
 
• The Index provides current and reliable information to policymakers, civil society organizations, academics, citizens, and legal professionals, among others.
